Flyover-specific listing copy — what translates differently

Aerial city preview listings use vocabulary general utility guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese App Store readers describe Apple's Flyover feature — not a literal paste of US marketing:

Flyover phrasing

US pages use "Flyover", "3D Aerial City Flyover", "Explore Cities in 3D", "Cinematic City Tour", "Flyover Cities", or "Bird's-Eye City View." Apple's Simplified Chinese Maps vocabulary often uses 航拍 for aerial city photography and overhead marketing, 鸟瞰 for bird's-eye city overview callouts, 3D 城市飞越 for 3D aerial city flyover frames, 飞行俯瞰 for general Flyover feature marketing, and 三维城市 for 3D city exploration outcome marketing. AppLocale aligns phrasing with Apple's consumer-facing terms while keeping your app's voice — not inventing aerial workflows Apple Maps does not offer.

Flythrough vs explore vs preview

Screenshot overlays differ by workflow step — Flyover play button on the map pin, cinematic city flythrough in progress, or exit back to route planning. Chinese buyers expect concise labels on gallery frames that match the step shown — 航拍 for general aerial entry, 3D 城市飞越 for flythrough frames, 鸟瞰 for bird's-eye outcome — not English "Flyover" pasted through machine translation.

Flyover vs Look Around

Flyover is 3D aerial city flyover from above — 航拍, 鸟瞰, 3D 城市飞越. Look Around is street-level 360 imagery and immersive neighborhood preview — 环视, 街景环视. When your English listing markets both aerial and street-level preview, zh-Hans overlays must separate Flyover vocabulary from Look Around vocabulary — distinct buyer promises with different screenshot frames on the same product page.

Flyover vs MapKit directions, Offline Maps, EV Routing, or Share ETA

Flyover is cinematic city exploration from above. MapKit directions is turn-by-turn and nearby discovery — 地图 / 导航 is not 航拍. Offline Maps is region download — 离线地图 is not 3D city flyover. EV Routing is electric vehicle route planning — 电动车路线 is not aerial city tours. Share ETA is trip safety updates — 分享预计到达时间 is not Flyover.
